g.text: Action supervision trains the blue and teal blocks together. This stage supplies GT pose; it does not train a pose estimator.

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677a

g.text: Both arms use matched data, initialization, training budget, and evaluation. All full-task actions come from the visual policy.
